name: What are the hidden costs associated with owning a waterfront home in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What are the hidden costs associated with owning a waterfront home in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond the purchase price, waterfront homes in South Florida can have several hidden costs. These often include higher property insurance premiums (especially for flood and wind), increased maintenance for seawalls, docks, and marine equipment, and potential HOA fees in waterfront communities. Utility costs can also be higher due to features like pools or extensive landscaping. Kelby Contreras helps buyers in locations like West Palm Beach or Doral anticipate these expenses, providing a clearer picture of the total cost of ownership and ensuring no financial surprises post-purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hidden costs include higher insurance premiums, increased maintenance for marine structures, and potentially higher utility/HOA fees. Anticipating these helps provide a clearer picture of total ownership costs.
